title: Target Sum
keyIdea: Put '+' or '−' before each number to hit target. If the '+' numbers sum to P, then P − (total − P) = target, so P = (total + target) / 2. Count subsets with sum P using a 0/1 knapsack row (backwards).

approaches.name: Count subsets with sum P
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). Reject if |target| > total or (total + target) is odd; dp[0] = 1; for each x, for s = P down to x: dp[s] += dp[s − x].
approaches.why: n numbers × P sums; one row.

options: '+' sum − '−' sum = target and '+' sum + '−' sum = total
Each number can be used at most once (0/1 knapsack)

quiz.q: How do zeros affect the count?
options: Each 0 can be + or −, doubling the count; dp[s] += dp[s] does that
